fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance at the SW corner of the building: the truck driveway pinches around a guard-booth island (~34.17760,-80.68250) before fanning out to the dock apron and the east trailer yard. Single point of vehicular access to the property (all other sides are wooded buffer).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small square ~1-vehicle-footprint booth visible at z20 sitting in the landscaped island where the in/out truck lanes split, beside the dock-yard entrance.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved apron at the gate split and a very wide internal truck court give ample room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Web sources state 238 overhead doors; satellite confirms long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in along the SW wall and the SE-facing walls. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Massive on-site trailer drop yard on the E/SE filling the apron with hundreds of parked trailers; facility designed for 1,200+ trailers. Band 50+.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single combined entry/exit drive at the gate split; lane count approximate from overhead.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town site in Lugoff SC surrounded by woods in Heritage Pointe Industrial Park, off US-1. Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Set in an industrial park near US-1 with adjacent development; cellular coverage likely adequate, so false.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide internal truck court between the gate and the dock doors provides inside-gate queuing room.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 68.5 ac is the traced operational footprint (building + paved trailer yard + auto parking). County/Target sources cite a 184-ac parcel; the balance is wooded buffer outside the active fence line.
